normalization: Deployment addresses map bijectively to logical domain identities.
Registered fixture accounts map bijectively to logical players; gameplay ownership is compared after that mapping.

Dojo RNG and native ActionNonce, ExecutionHead and ExecutionResult are transport records. Native terminal domain rejection consumes its accepted nonce and order while rolling back gameplay; Dojo rejection rolls back the transaction. Gameplay rows remain equal.
Transaction hashes and event positions identify execution, not gameplay rows; historical ids still consume the same allocation sequence.
SeasonPrize.pool is fixed at zero: no prize deposit or payout is in the slice; season points remain compared.
HyperstructureGlobals.completed_count is fixed at zero: foundation discovery is supported, completion is not; discovered count remains compared.

execution.resourcesScope: Fixture totals include both world deployments, configuration, actions, assertions and trace serialization. Per-action resources are measured by the lab harness.
